tasks.title: Scan error must not read as Clean
tasks.objective: A per-file scan failure (unreadable/locked file, hash error) must surface as an explicit error verdict, never a silent Verdict::Clean. Fixes PM review finding F1.
tasks.commit: fix(scan): surface per-file scan errors instead of false Clean
tasks.notes:
PM review F1: in core/src/scan/engine.rs, scan_all_with_progress currently does `scan_entry(cfg, entry).unwrap_or_else(|_| ScanResult{ ... verdict: Verdict::Clean ... })` — a file that fails to hash/read is silently reported CLEAN. This contradicts docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ('absence of detection is never reported as clean') and lets malware that locks its own file evade detection.

REQUIRED CHANGES:
1. In core/src/scan/result.rs add a third Verdict variant `Error` (serde rename 'error'). Add an OPTIONAL `error: Option<String>` field to ScanResult (serde default, skip_serializing_if None) OR carry the message via a Finding — pick the smaller change but the error MUST be represented, not dropped.
2. In engine.rs, on scan_entry Err, produce a ScanResult with `verdict: Verdict::Error` and the error text — do NOT map to Clean. Keep sha256 empty for the error case.
3. Update gui/src/app.rs: the malicious metric must NOT count Error results as clean; show Error rows distinctly (e.g. count/label). Do not let an Error verdict be filtered away as if clean.
4. ADD TESTS: (a) a file that cannot be read yields Verdict::Error (simulate via a path that does not exist or a directory), (b) an Error result is not counted as Malicious NOR silently dropped. Keep ALL existing tests green.

Do NOT weaken any existing detection. Whole-workspace `cargo test` must stay green (currently 57 passing; this task adds at least one more, so min is 58).
acceptance: Verdict has an Error variant; a scan_entry failure yields Verdict::Error, never Clean
the error message is preserved on the ScanResult (not dropped)
GUI does not count/treat Error results as clean; they are visible
new test proves unreadable file -> Verdict::Error; all prior tests still pass
cargo clippy --workspace clean; no unwrap/expect added to library paths
